title: Coils
author: Marisol Reyes, rigger
pages: Forty-one coils pulled today, each the size of a coffee can. Hold two close together and the hair on your arm stands up.
Odessa wants them stacked at the River Arts warehouse, away from the county. Teo wired one to a car battery as a joke and it lit the whole yard for an hour. Nobody laughed after.
